Bhagat Singh Photo in Voter Roll Sparks Row in Ludhiana

A photograph of Bhagat Singh appeared on a voter roll in Ludhiana, triggering a controversy. Officials stated that the inclusion of the photograph was an error and has since been corrected. The incident occurred amid broader scrutiny of electoral rolls.
